name: mcp_crm_list_customers
description: List customers in the CRM with pagination, optional owner filter. Returns customer ids and names.

name: mcp_crm_get_customer_profile
description: Get the full profile of one CRM customer: contact info, company, owner, lifecycle stage and custom fields.

name: mcp_crm_update_customer_stage
description: Update the lifecycle stage of a CRM customer, e.g. from lead to qualified.

name: mcp_crm_list_activities
description: List recent CRM activities (calls, meetings, notes) for a customer or owner.

name: mcp_crm_log_activity
description: Log a new CRM activity such as a phone call or a meeting note against a customer.

name: mcp_crm_add_tag
description: Attach a tag to a CRM customer for segmentation.

name: mcp_crm_search_customers_by_name
description: Search CRM customers by (partial) name or phone number.

name: mcp_crm_list_opportunities
description: List CRM opportunities with amount, stage and expected close date.

name: mcp_crm_update_opportunity_amount
description: Update the amount or stage of an existing CRM opportunity.

name: mcp_support_list_tickets
description: List support tickets with status, priority and assignee.

name: mcp_support_get_ticket
description: Get one support ticket including full conversation history and SLA information.

name: mcp_support_update_ticket_status
description: Change the status of a support ticket, e.g. mark it resolved or escalate it.

name: mcp_support_search_tickets_by_keyword
description: Search support tickets by keyword across subjects and bodies.

name: mcp_billing_list_invoices
description: List invoices with amount, due date and payment status.

name: mcp_billing_get_invoice
description: Get one invoice with line items, tax and payment history.

name: mcp_billing_list_payments
description: List received payments and their allocation to invoices.

name: mcp_billing_list_refunds
description: List refund requests with reason and approval state.

name: mcp_calendar_list_events
description: List calendar events in a time range for one or more attendees.

name: mcp_calendar_create_event
description: Create a calendar event with attendees, location and reminder.

name: mcp_calendar_update_event
description: Reschedule or edit an existing calendar event.

name: mcp_calendar_find_free_slots
description: Find common free time slots for several attendees within a date range.

name: mcp_email_send_email
description: Send an email with subject, body and attachments to one or more recipients.

name: mcp_email_list_threads
description: List email threads in a mailbox with last message time and participants.

name: mcp_email_search_mail
description: Search mail across subject, body and attachments by keyword.

name: mcp_sheet_read_range
description: Read a cell range from a spreadsheet and return rows as JSON.

name: mcp_sheet_append_rows
description: Append rows to the end of a spreadsheet sheet.

name: mcp_sheet_export_rows
description: Export rows or query results into a spreadsheet as a downloadable file.

name: mcp_sheet_create_sheet
description: Create a new spreadsheet with the given title and headers.

name: mcp_analytics_query_metrics
description: Run an analytics query over business metrics for a given date range and dimension.

name: mcp_analytics_list_dashboards
description: List available analytics dashboards and their owners.

name: mcp_analytics_get_funnel
description: Get funnel conversion numbers for a stage sequence in a date range.

name: mcp_warehouse_list_products
description: List warehouse products with SKU, price and category.

name: mcp_warehouse_get_inventory
description: Get current inventory levels per SKU and warehouse location.

name: mcp_warehouse_list_shipments
description: List shipments with carrier, status and estimated arrival date.

name: mcp_task_create_task
description: Create a task with assignee, due date and priority in the task system.

name: mcp_task_list_tasks
description: List tasks for an assignee with status and due date filters.

name: mcp_task_complete_task
description: Mark an existing task as completed.

name: mcp_kb_search_knowledge
description: Search the internal knowledge base by keyword and return matching articles.

name: mcp_kb_get_article
description: Get one knowledge base article with full body and version history.

name: mcp_kb_list_categories
description: List knowledge base categories and article counts.

name: mcp_hr_list_employees
description: List employees with department, role and manager.

name: mcp_hr_get_team_roster
description: Get the roster of a team including shift availability.

name: mcp_doc_read_document
description: Read a document and return its extracted text content.

name: mcp_doc_export_pdf
description: Export a document to PDF and return a download link.

name: mcp_notify_send_webhook
description: Send a webhook notification to a configured channel with a JSON payload.
